digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify gate and corpus test infrastructure
propositions: Complete live-Pandoc corpus replay contributes a measured 184.32-second macOS lower bound to Gerrit Verify per-change execution time.
ADR 0096 approves a two-cadence verification boundary that splits corpus assertions into committed deterministic static outputs and a separate full-replay external job.
The implementation must reduce per-change subprocess work while retaining all behavioral assertions, supported Python cells, supported operating systems, and complete real-Pandoc replay capability.

A static converter backed by committed Pandoc 3.6.1 artifacts must drive the production segmenting renderer through all corpus strata (code_arrow, table, prose) with identical assertion coverage while retaining three representative live bodies and compact probes.

An external Integration job must run full corpus replay on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms on a weekly schedule and via workflow_dispatch to validate committed fixtures against real Pandoc.
